text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I need to ask Narita Taishin something, so I go looking for her on the rooftop. I don't see her right away, but then I hear a voice…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ugh, another ad? I've hardly been able to progress the story because of these damn ads…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh, what's this one? "Real results in just three days!" "Get rid of old, dead skin cells!" "Reveal a fresher, brighter you!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
choice_data_list: Don't even think about buying shady products like that!
Don't even think about buying shady products like that!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Don't scare me like that. I'm not gullible enough to believe something so stupid, anyway!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So she says, but it seems like she's worried about her skin.
